claims: ActionAutoCalRifExecute is a separate modal Modify Map Refs path, not one of the 0x24 mode wrappers.
TFormRifAutocal.ButtonOkClick @ 0x0051B910 validates and writes the 18 MAP reference points into TAutoCalDM.MNFLD_PRESS_THD (+0x6C).
The same confirmation path writes the petrol injection-time reference vector TAutoCalDM.PETR_INJ_TBP (+0x70).
If the new MAP endpoints exceed the existing allowed range, it updates LIMIT_PRESSURE_MAX (+0xB4) and/or LIMIT_PRESSURE_MIN (+0xA8).
The writes use native TAebVector/TAebNumber setters, so this is an ECU-backed mutation path rather than a chart-only edit.
evidence: Raw RTTI proof maps ActionAutoCalRifExecute to 0x005187A0 and shows it is not a push-mode wrapper.
0x0051B910 loops 18 times and calls TAebVector_SetDouble on AutoCalDM +0x6C.
0x0051B910 loops over PETR_INJ_TBP vector length and calls TAebVector_SetDouble on AutoCalDM +0x70.
0x0051B910 compares first/last MAP references against AutoCalDM +0xA8/+0xB4 and calls TAebNumber_SetDouble when limits must expand.
Native TAeb setters continue through SetData/SetDataInEcu in the recovered ProgBase class path.
The supplied Portmons contain reads of these native objects but do not contain a captured confirmation transaction; therefore exact write-frame bytes are not claimed.
